}} The '''Oceanic Rug''' is a piece of furniture. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|1250}}, or be purchased from the [[Island Trader]] for three [[Blue Discus]] every Saturday. It may randomly appear in the [[Traveling Cart]]'s stock for {{Tprice|furniture}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
